raw_response:
This plot is small, only a bit bigger than a quarter of a timad, so I will mostly work it myself with my family. Beans are good because they feed the soil, so I do not need much chemical fertilizer — maybe just a small bag of DAP at planting to help them start, but I cannot afford urea on top. I will put some manure from my cattle since I have it at home, and I will use the local bean seed I saved from last season because improved seed is expensive and hard to find here in Oromia. I do not have irrigation on this plot, it depends on the meher rains, and I will only buy a little pesticide if I see bean flies or aphids damaging the crop.
